features.statement: Page title leads with the brand name followed by a longer descriptive tagline.
Uses semantic landmarks such as main and article elements and some ARIA attributes.
Heading hierarchy is clean and sequential: h1, then h2 sections, h3 items, h4 only in footer columns.
Each product or card item gets its own h3 heading.
Typography uses only the system-ui font stack with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Section headings are bold (700) rather than light weight.
Body text is slightly larger (17px) with generous line height (about 1.65).
Body text uses a blue-tinted dark slate color rather than neutral near-black.
Palette is dark navy with a brick-red accent, replacing light cyan and green tones.
Links are red and underlined.
Primary buttons are solid red-filled with moderately rounded corners; secondary buttons are outlined.
Rounded corners are widely applied to cards, buttons and containers.
Layout relies on CSS grid alongside flexbox.
Product images have descriptive alt text naming the item, such as 'box'.
Hero places the product image inside a white card with title, tagline and red CTA.
Header is compact: bold logo and a single-row nav ending in a red CTA button.
Intro text is split into two columns.
A row of bordered feature cards with short titles summarizes key capabilities.
Products appear as white bordered cards with large red prices, full-width buttons, and a highlighted featured card with badge.
Secondary promos appear as compact horizontal banners with a small thumbnail and outlined button.
Secondary actions like 'Compare' are outlined buttons placed below the cards.
Struck-through original prices use semantic s elements.
Footer is very dark navy with light text and bold white column headings.
Soft box shadows appear sparingly on the hero card and key images.
Content sits in a centered column about 1080px wide with consistent side gutters.
Copy adds persuasive microcopy: subtitles, taglines, badges like 'MOST COMPLETE', and price phrasing.
Footer is trimmed to a few links per column.
Markup is lean: few divs, no scripts or external stylesheets, a single style block, few classes.
Button and link labels use sentence case, with plain-text arrow glyphs instead of icon fonts.
